about: Questions over the 441-issue Linear corpus (build-linear-corpus.ts; the corpus itself stays in /tmp) whose answer needs two or more documents. Labelled by hand from the issue texts on 2026-09-06 by one annotator (the author); each expected set was checked against the issue bodies, not just the titles. Types: multi-hop (the answer combines specific documents), aggregation (every document of one kind), corpus (a question about the shape of the corpus). Scored on retrieval — did the expected documents come back in the top ten — because that is what any answering step would have to work from. Aggregation and corpus questions also carry `keyword`: the needle a person would type into search_thoughts_keyword (SMD-944) for that question, so the keyword tool the product already ships is compared too; multi-hop questions have no single needle and are not scored on that arm.
